test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 22 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a certain coded language 'APICES' is coded as "WZYCKM' and 'SUITED' is coded as 'OZPCPX". How will 'CASINO' be coded in the same code language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0456c47f0f8406ca284fe7bf63d8b31b17c81319675f3e67360d56add58b20a3.png] 

The logic followed here is:

For, ‘APICES’ is written as WZYCKM,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/02ae060aee7d68861b91ba5095b79767bc121bb1c4f71985b4fb8d02bee59837.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bf96ed3742fc5599fe58655f74e8a33aa140da4801f2861a323a56cc16253a26.png] 

For, ‘SUITED’ is written as OZPCPX,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/790c00d3ca8cb7506ce11f39be112ebe8a7bdeb7a75285a12c6c206148963667.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8e57ff88235254b6a5bc2d0e932e44dfce5009e591f1068a84ab132e2118dd04.png] 

Similarly, for ‘CASINO’,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d327eb122f01c8f79cb2dd27253df21d00565dc6d679b289030b0acdf70aedc1.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d18b751451f13ec6b7692bdd84158f107a87c986b9efd436a29e823556d9c1ae.png] 

So, ‘CASINO’ will be written as ‘XJFLTK’.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
